title: The role of readiness factors in E-learning outcomes: An empirical study
reason: Respondents are 96 teachers at Tehran high schools (not HE/VET students). Secondarily all variables (e-learning factors, readiness, outcomes) come from one questionnaire; 'LMS' here means latent moderated structuring.
